title: Gemini 4 Argon: the Chat to Task switch

outro.cta: Follow for AI news that actually matters

scenes.vo: Google just gave Gemini a new switch. And it changes how you use AI.
scenes.visual: The Gemini sparkle spins over a Chat | Task toggle; the cursor flips it to Task on 'switch' and Gemini's colours bloom.

scenes.vo: It comes with Gemini 4 Argon, Google's new frontier model. It launched on October thirteenth, for Pro and Ultra subscribers.
scenes.visual: Gemini 4 Argon lockup; a 13 OCT calendar tile drops with spec chips; four plan cards where only AI Pro and AI Ultra light up, prices in rupees.

scenes.vo: On a test of automating real business work, Google says it beats GPT 6 and Claude.
scenes.visual: Four bars race; Argon's gradient bar wins at 51.3%.

scenes.vo: Here's the shift. Flip the toggle to Task, and hand it a job. Then close your laptop. Gemini keeps working.

data.prompt: Every Monday at 9, sort my inbox, summarize client emails and draft replies

scenes.visual: Inside a laptop, the Gemini box flips to Task, a scheduled prompt types and submits; the lid closes and a running task card ticks results.

scenes.vo: You can run up to fifteen at once. Price alerts, news digests, research packs with sources.
scenes.visual: A gradient 15 counts up over a row of 15 live task pips; three finished task cards land.

scenes.vo: In Google's own demo, it turns a messy project folder into a client proposal deck, emails it, and sets up a workflow for every new request.
scenes.visual: Badly named files float, then get sucked into a clean deck; an email sends; a looping scheduled workflow draws.

scenes.vo: The catch? It still makes things up, it trails Claude on some coding tests, and tasks are still experimental.
scenes.visual: A Gemini answer glitches and its wrong number is struck out; Terminal-bench bars show Argon behind; an EXPERIMENTAL stamp slams.

scenes.vo: So, would you hand your work to an AI? Tell me in the comments.

replies.name: Priya
replies.text: Already did. My inbox runs itself 🙌

replies.name: Rahul
replies.text: Not my client emails. No way.

replies.name: Meera
replies.text: Only if I review before it sends

replies.name: Arjun
replies.text: Research while I sleep? Yes please

scenes.visual: The toggle wobbles between Chat and Task; a Delegate vs No way counter ticks as example replies land.
